The integrand V[>] at cntn_to_dcsn.value must be integrable for cntn_to_dcsn.value:Expectation:1 under Port2:distribution:Ψ_θ.
The equations at cntn_to_dcsn.value must define cntn_to_dcsn:Aggregation on its declared inputs with values in its declared output sets.

The integrand D_{m_next}V[>]*(Ψ - R) at policy.foc must be integrable for policy.foc:Expectation:1 under Port2:distribution:Ψ_θ.
The distribution of Ψ, θ gives probability only to values in the declared shock sets.
